description: The Hotshots is a team of four tackling Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots. We're building an Oklahoma fire map and burn calendar that merges 20+ years of NASA satellite fire data into one consistent record, separates wildfires from prescribed burns, and flags unusual fire activity. We love Earth science, data and storytelling. Our team is complete, but we'd welcome mentors with GIS or fire science experience!
